title: Independent assay blocks and shallow-history fitness gain

source_evidence.location: Methods: competition assays; Results: shallow-history analysis
source_evidence.finding: The study reports negative initial-fitness versus fitness-change correlations in 15 of 16 comparisons and uses fourfold fitness-assay replication.
Shared measurement error between an initial value and a change score can mechanically bias their correlation.

data_evidence.location: Official archive manifest and verified raw files

layers.system: Evolving E. coli populations under controlled environments
layers.unit: Evolutionary population measured in an assay block
layers.measurement: Replicated competition-assay fitness and fitness-change values
layers.published_inference: Fitter ancestral populations tend to gain less fitness
layers.validation_gap: The published-style statistic reuses a noisy baseline inside the change score.

plain_language_verdict: A striking pattern became much weaker when the starting measurement and later change were separated.
limitations: The final independent-block estimate is attenuated and uncertain rather than a definitive biological refutation.
Assay-block exchangeability and weighted errors-in-variables sensitivity remain open verification gaps.

title: Repeated animals, infection status, and seasonal fat change

source_evidence.location: Methods: energetic-cost GLMMs; Discussion and Conclusions
source_evidence.finding: The study models seasonal fat change with animal ID as a random intercept and interprets pathogen-associated reductions as energetic costs.
A meta-analysis reports heterogeneous condition-infection associations and recommends longitudinal or experimental designs for stronger inference.

layers.system: Repeatedly observed bighorn sheep across seasons and herds
layers.unit: Animal-season interval with repeated animal identifiers
layers.measurement: Fat change, pathogen status, acquisition, clearance, and covariates
layers.published_inference: Pathogen status has an energetic cost expressed as fat loss
layers.validation_gap: A random intercept does not by itself separate an animal's change in exposure from stable differences between animals or herds.

plain_language_verdict: The data can test whether the association follows the same animal, but cannot by itself prove why it does.
limitations: Unmeasured food, contact, and immune variables prevent causal interpretation.
Wildlife-disease and longitudinal-inference expertise remains required for selection.

title: Source-extraction decisions in a shared meta-analysis database

source_evidence.finding: The database retains constituent-database identity and potential duplicates and flags contrasting conclusions and data-extractor bias as an analysis opportunity.
The abstract reports that researcher effects can outweigh original effects and belowground-biomass conclusions can change sign across meta-analyses.

layers.system: Global-change experimental results assembled from multiple databases
layers.unit: Extracted outcome record linked to source experiment and database
layers.measurement: Treatment/control summaries, uncertainty, replication, units, and metadata
layers.published_inference: Pooled moderator conclusions describe global-change responses
layers.validation_gap: Extraction, duplicate handling, and aggregation choices can alter which source records enter a pooled estimate.

plain_language_verdict: A conclusion may change because researchers built the evidence table differently, not because the underlying experiments changed.
limitations: A current conference result narrows novelty for an independent reconciliation study.
Author-overlap and domain-specialist review are unresolved gates.

title: Aging shifts the calibration curve used for voltage-based diagnosis

source_evidence.finding: The paper reports that a fresh-cell open-circuit-voltage curve degrades aged-cell accuracy and identifies joint curve estimation as a needed extension.

data_evidence.location: Experimental CSV files, condition-specific OCV curves, and MATLAB inventory

layers.system: Lithium-ion cells measured across fresh and aged conditions
layers.unit: Cell trajectory under a documented operating condition
layers.measurement: Voltage, current, temperature, capacity, resistance, and OCV curves
layers.published_inference: Voltage-controlled diagnosis can identify capacity and resistance
layers.validation_gap: A calibration curve learned in one cell condition need not remain valid after aging.

plain_language_verdict: A diagnostic method can look accurate until the reference curve changes with the thing being diagnosed.
limitations: The closest primary paper already demonstrates this boundary and names the needed extension.
A new target would need a distinct consequence, not another version of the published comparison.

title: Model-triggered biocontrol evaluated from epidemic-level summaries

source_evidence.finding: The study compares calendar and model strategies across four epidemics and reports an epidemic-by-treatment analysis.

layers.unit: Treatment-by-epidemic summary rather than individual plot outcome
layers.published_inference: A model-triggered strategy can retain efficacy while reducing applications
layers.validation_gap: The deposited table lacks plot replicates and application events needed to independently test robustness across epidemics.

plain_language_verdict: The question may be important, but the public table is too compressed to test it properly.
limitations: Only 20 treatment-epidemic summaries are publicly available.
The closest paper already tests the proposed epidemic-by-treatment interaction.

title: Early magnetic signal proposed as a fatigue-life predictor

source_evidence.finding: The paper fits an M–N relationship and reports early-life correlations using the same 19 soft-magnetic-iron specimens.

data_evidence.location: Official file metadata and failed content retrieval receipt

layers.system: Fatigue-tested magnetic materials across five materials
layers.unit: Physical specimen with force, displacement, and magnetic measurements
layers.measurement: Early magnetic drift and later fatigue life
layers.published_inference: Early magnetic drift predicts fatigue life
layers.validation_gap: The claimed relation requires specimen-held-out and material-held-out evaluation, but the official files could not be acquired for a real-sample audit.

plain_language_verdict: A persuasive validation question cannot be checked until the actual public files can be acquired.
limitations: The official archive and supplementary workbook returned HTTP 403 during acquisition attempts.
Landing-page metadata is not accepted as evidence that the required variables are available.
